schema_note: This document follows the wave10 function-handoff.v1 field set and adds five keys the wave10 shape did not need: the two decompilation_defects_corrected and unresolved_questions lists that carry the corrected evidence, observed_body.instruction_count_source, ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 and implementation.boundary_test.
semantic_label: texture zero full region: blit the texture one raster through texture slot zero over the unit square with the colour write off

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x28
abi.return_contract: MOV AL,0x1 at 0x00518cdf writes only the low lane, so the model returns the widened one

observed_body.instruction_count_source: the reviewed staging handoff for this address
instruction_list: read the painter twice through the system port 0x00401080, once for texture slot zero and once for texture slot one
start the render on texture slot zero, clear the colour write and set the material to 0x58653eac
read the raster pointer at texture slot one + 0x60, raise the raster count when it is non-null and bind it at +0x3c
paint the unit rectangle, restore the colour write, end the render and answer one

mechanics: read the painter twice through the system port 0x00401080, once for texture slot zero and once for texture slot one
start the render on texture slot zero, clear the colour write and set the material to 0x58653eac
read the raster pointer at texture slot one + 0x60, raise the raster count when it is non-null and bind it at +0x3c
paint the unit rectangle, restore the colour write, end the render and answer one
runtime_gates: the receiver is never dereferenced; the target reads the painter only through the system port
all five ports are dependency-only, so the blit is unverified in this package
the raster count raise is conditional on a non-null raster, so the count field is not always raised
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation samples the system once; the assembly calls the 0x00401080 port twice, once for each texture slot, so the corrected model keeps both samples
the decompilation binds the raster unconditionally; the assembly raises the raster count only when the raster pointer is non-null, so the model keeps the guard

ghidra_provenance.evidence_rule: The disassembly listed in observed_body was read back from the live Ghidra database for SporeApp.exe at the addresses shown, and the byte extent, its length and its sha256 were computed from the .text section of SPORE/SporeBin/SporeApp.exe (.text VMA 0x00401000, file offset 0x400). The sha256 below covers exactly that byte extent; ghidra_provenance.binary_sha256 records the whole file. No Ghidra symbol, structure, comment or program state was created or modified.
